headline: Portuguese Prime Minister Details His Plan Against High Living Costs, Without Touching VAT
summary: Prime Minister Luís Montenegro estimates the current cost-of-living situation could last. Unlike other European countries, he will not cut the consumption tax (VAT).
why: Consumption taxes and living-cost policy shape household spending and inflation, which in turn influence central bank decisions and consumer-facing equities.
